notes.title: Update V1.3.0-EA
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

The next major content update for Spirit Valley is here! This time we’re headed north to the Arctic Isles. Let’s take a look at what we’ve been cooking!

[h2]New zone: Arctic Isles[/h2]

The next chapter of Spirit Valley plays out in the frozen north in an area called the Arctic Isles. In this area we have a whole bunch of new Spirits to catch and characters to meet. There’s also new equipment and new side quests. You’ll also finally come face to face with the main antagonist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798634/2a1d7715d04a441499fd569317f00596741a70df.png[/img]

[h2]New Spirits[/h2]

This new update brings 13 new Spirits to add to your collection. Many of these new spirits have been designed based on the requests we’ve heard from our community. They also each come with a rare variation. There’s also a legendary Spirit to catch but that will be no easy feat! You’ll have to complete a quest chain to catch this elusive Spirit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798634/1254743fc1073ce720ee36b3e17c0c558ea4b4eb.png[/img]

[h2]Other new features[/h2]

Many of our players have been hoping for an item which would make it easier to level up your Spirits. We’ve heard your wishes and there’s now new XP Booster items in the game. XP Boosters can be found from chests around the world and can be purchased from merchants in Dusty Vale and Paradise Island.

Another feature which has been often requested is more options for faster combat speeds. There’s now a new “Very Fast” option for combat speed, which doubles the speed of the combat animations making the game much faster. We’ve also adjusted the timing and speed of all combat animations on all combat speed levels. 

[h2]Balancing and tweaks[/h2]

[list]
[*]Accuracy debuffs no longer affect purely defensive skills.
[*]Purely defensive Skills is a skill that doesn't target the opposing Spirit or team in any way (deal damage or apply debuffs/status effects).
[*]Skills that have both defensive and offensive attributes are affected by accuracy debuffs.
[*]Updates to Merchants
[*]Infinite stock of potions and other consumables.
[*]Added Infinity Charm (disable evolution) and Evolution Charm (enabled evolution) items to all Merchants.
[*]New XP Booster item added to Merchants in Dusty Vale and Paradise Island
[*]Re-rolling Trait with Trait-o-matic 5000 is now guaranteed to randomize a different Trait than Spirit's current Trait.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed wrong debuff in skill Twerk from decrease defence to decrease accuracy.
[*]Fixed Lacteena's duplicate skill.
[*]Fixed bug where it was possible to use Skill without sufficient stamina when stamina cost increase status effect was applied.
[*]Fixed Serpentax speed base stat from 105 to 125.
[*]Translation fixes.
[*]Fixed Trait-o-matic 5000 input issue where hitting cancel right after selecting "go again" sometimes softlocked the UI.
[/list]

That’s all for now! We’re already hard at work on creating more content for the game. Our next big step is to bring the game’s main story to a conclusion. Hopefully we will be able to achieve that sometime later this year. 


And last but not least, a big thanks to everyone playing our game! We’ll see you in the next update.

- Otterside Games

notes.title: Update V1.2.0-EA
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The time has come for our first major content update! In this update, we're taking you to the sunny beaches of Paradise Island. Let's take a look at what we have in store for you!

[h2]New zone: Paradise Island[/h2]
The next chapter of our story takes place on Paradise Island. The nudist community of Coconut Village is in trouble and it is up to our heroes to save the day. On Paradise Island you can catch new Spirits, meet new NPCs, discover new side quests, find new equipment, and learn how to fish!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798634/3292d793b41b880026a4dfa35b0fe0bd9a210bb9.png[/img]

[h2]New Spirits[/h2]
On Paradise Island you can catch and fuck 14 new Spirits! Each Spirit also has a rare variation to hunt down. We've also added a completely new Spirit type to the game: Aquatic Spirits. Aquatic Spirits mostly live in water which brings us to our next new feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798634/f58af53cd3203b4b47fb07dad5385748e16b0b6f.png[/img]

[h2]Fishing![/h2]
Find a quiet spot, enjoy the scenery, relax, and cast your fishing line. But watch out! You just might catch an angry Sharky! The new Aquatic Spirits can mostly be found on dedicated fishing spots around Paradise Island. Once you receive the fishing rod, you can use the fishing spots to catch spirits, gold, and tasty treats to feed to your Spirits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798634/1c322bcc604a9bd4ea3eb50cdac8b14b5fd633b1.gif[/img]

[h2]Other new features[/h2]
We've received many requests for new features from our players, and here's some new stuff to address those requests:
[list]
[*]The affection points of Spirits can now be reset by using the Fallen Star item.
[*]Spirits can be stopped from evolving with the Infinity Charm item. Evolutions can be turned back on with the Evolution Charm.
[*]The Trait-o-matic 5000: This device will allow you to re-roll the Trait of any Spirit. It can be found on all Spirit Clinics and can be used as many times as needed for a small price.
[*]An elemental effectiveness chart can now be found in the pause menu.
[/list]

[h2]Balancing and other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Status effects applied to Spirits during battles are now always executed after both parties have taken their turns to make countering status effects work consistently with both Items and skills.
[*]Seed of Life skill heal amount changed from 45% to 30% (from max health).
[*]Spirit can now be released immediately after it's captured without first sending to team or storage.
[*]Show Spirit's trait in Storage Menu details panel.
[*]Added possibility to select which Spirit is handed over when returning a Quests that requires to do so. Previously lowest level spirit was always handed over.
[*]Application can now be set to run in background. This must be enabled in Settings explicitly.
[/list]

That's all for now but new content is already in the works! And as always, a big thank you to all of our players and everyone who's been supporting us on this journey. We're still reading all feedback as development continues, and we'll be adding some of the most requested features to the game.

Thanks again and we'll see you in the next update!

-Otterside Games

notes.title: Update V1.1.1-EA
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This patch mainly addresses an issue regarding achievements not unlocking correctly.

Some players has experienced an issue where Steam features are not working during the first game session after installation. More specifically, resolving the problem requires restarting Steam client app completely.

Unfortunately it seems there isn't much we can do about the underlying issue, except mitigating it's impacts. To do so we have added a local storage for achievements to ensure that data is retained in all situations.

[h3]Here's a quick rundown what to expect when you fire up the new patch[/h3]

[u]New players[/u]
[list]
[*]You may still encounter the problem where achievements are not unlocking in real time during first game session.
[*]However, data is now stored locally and synced to Steam next time game is launched. Your achievements will unlock then.
[/list]

[u]Existing players [/u]
[list]
[*]Achievements are unlocked retrospectively during first launch, provided its unlock condition is met.
[*]Keep in mind that some data is lost and not all achievements can be restored. However, these should be easy enough to unlock just by playing the game once next content update drops.
[/list]

This patch should alleviates the most severe symptoms of this issue.
We continue to monitor the situation and react accordingly.

[h3]Other Changes & fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*]Added 144Hz FPS option to screen settings
[*]Allow user to select any resolution supported by the game (was previously filtered to leave out resolutions that user's screen didn't support).
[*]Text fixes
[*]Fixed Item effect descriptions not fitting in UI in some languages.
[*]Fixed bug where Spirit's current HP could end up larger than maximum HP when removing equipment from the Spirit.
[/list]

A big thanks to all for reporting issues and giving feedback!
Special thanks to our community testers, your help has been invaluable to address this issue.


Happy gaming!

- Otterside Games

notes.title: Update V1.1.0-EA
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Spirit Valley has now been out for a couple of weeks and we've received lots of great feedback from you guys! In this first small update we will try to fix some of the issues many have complained about. There's also lots of bug fixes and some new content as well! Let's see what we've been cooking.

[h2]Rare Spirits[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798634/b6f5981e9e9b9e806488e75eb8263521de701585.png[/img]

One of the most requested features has been rare versions of the Spirits. This new update brings a rare version of each Spirit with a new color scheme. The new colors apply to the combat sprites and lewd animations as well. The chance to encounter rare Spirits is fairly high and there is a new consumable item that helps you track down each rare. We will be listening to your feedback on the rares and adjust encounter rates in future updates if needed.

[h2]New Consumables[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44798634/4fc192ecf7a71e922a2a7624ec51823c84934a85.png[/img]

We've added new types of consumable items which can be used while traveling through the world of Spirit Valley. These items can help you find more powerful Spirits, rare Spirits, or even completely avoid encountering Spirits.

We also received many requests for a way to deal with the poison effects in battles, so now you can use the Antidote to remove poison and the Cleansing Tonic to remove all debuffs. Status effects like poison and debuffs are now also displayed on the combat UI.

[h2]Balancing & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Poison status effect is now applied to Player's Spirit after turn action is taken, if action is "Send out", "Use item" or "Flee".
[*]Updates to catching wild Spirits
[list]
[*]Catch chance now increases after each failed catch attempt.
[*]Spirit Crystal item description updated to have more information about their effective level ranges.
[/list]
[*]Loot from wild Spirit encounters balanced
[*]Merchant inventories updated
[list]
[*]New consumables added to Merchant inventories
[*]Butt Plug of Wisdom added to Sex Shop inventory
[*]Infinite stock of Crystals and Consumables!
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Text fixes
[*]Font sizes adjusted in various places to fit UI (Russian, Korean).
[*]Don't lose input focus when clicking background with mouse after minigame completes.
[*]Adjusted mouse click intertact areas on Nurses and Merchants.
[*]Fixed bug where it was possible to close menu without making decision where to put new caight Spirit.
[*]Fixed Birdy's duplicate skills.
[*]Fixed bug where allocating affection points to Defence overwrote previously allocated Defence affection points, instead of adding them.
[*]Fixed bug that in certain cases prevented including Spirit's Trait bonus to stats shown in UI.
[*]Fixed issue which caused Spirit's Level to go out of sync with accumulated XP in some rare cases.
[*]Fixed bug where manually closing equipment window after giving equipment to Spirit caused it to not work wehen opened next time until scene change.
[*]Fixed sprite color in NPC Sarah idle animation.
[*]Fixed issue where minigames were not triggered after returning to overworld, if cutscene was played immediately.
[*]Fixed issue where it was possible to close team XP menu after battles, breaking the xp distribution and level up cycle.
[*]Fixed issue where it was possible to close team member selector popup in Inventory menu after selecting Spirit, leading various issues.
[*]Fixed bug where Captain Maria's autointeract was not disabled correcly after receiving Quest "An audience with the King" in Tumbleweed Town.
[*]Fxed Triboobe minigame lewd animation positioning.
[/list]

That's everything for now! We will be adding small tweaks, features, and fixes in new updates but our main focus is now on the next big update which adds a new area to explore, new characters to meet, and new Spirits to catch. We want to push the story forward and give you more fun stuff to play with. 

A big thanks to our players for joining us on this journey! The feedback you give helps us make the game better. Thanks again and we'll see you in the next update!

-Otterside Games

notes.title: Spirit Valley release delayed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Unfortunately we have some sad news to share. We will not be able to release Spirit Valley on October 25 as planned. 

We didn't realize that once we tag the game as Early Access, it would need to go through another review process, and we also needed to make some small changes to our store page. The review process usually doesn't take more than a few days, but until we pass the review, we can't give you an exact release date.

Now this is completely our own fault and we're so sorry to let you guys down.

We'll be posting updates on the situation as soon as we know anything, and hopefully we will be able to release the game as soon as next week.

- Otterside Games team
